about: References in a diagram, tested on the server (tests/test_diagrams_svg.py, model ids: {p} is empty) and on the client (ui/src/apps/diagram.test.js, the server's ids: {p} is dg-). A use or a marker reference is kept only when it is a same-drawing fragment #id that resolves inside the drawing: uses lists the ids kept uses point at, markers the kept marker attributes as name=id, in document order.

cases.name: use of a group in the drawing
cases.svg: <defs><g id="{p}a"><rect width="1" height="1"/></g></defs><use href="#{p}a" x="5" y="5"/>

cases.name: use by xlink:href of a group in the drawing
use of an id not in the drawing
use with a good href and an external xlink:href
use of a group that holds a use (a chain)
cases.svg: <g id="{p}a"><rect width="1" height="1"/></g><g id="{p}b"><use href="#{p}a"/></g><use href="#{p}b"/>

cases.name: use of a use
cases.svg: <g id="{p}a"><rect width="1" height="1"/></g><use id="{p}u" href="#{p}a"/><use href="#{p}u"/>

cases.name: use of a group holding a use that goes (after it)
use of a group holding a use that goes (before it)
use of the group it is in (a cycle)
marker in the drawing
cases.svg: <defs><marker id="{p}m"><path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z"/></marker></defs><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="9" y2="9" marker-end="url(#{p}m)"/>

cases.name: marker id not in the drawing
marker reference to something that is not a marker
cases.svg: <g id="{p}g"/><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="9" y2="9" marker-start="url(#{p}g)"/>

cases.name: marker at an external URL
cases.svg: <defs><marker id="{p}m"><path d="M0 0 L1 1"/></marker></defs><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="9" y2="9" marker-end="url(http://evil.example/m.svg#{p}m)"/>

cases.name: marker in another file
cases.svg: <defs><marker id="{p}m"><path d="M0 0 L1 1"/></marker></defs><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="9" y2="9" marker-end="url(m.svg#{p}m)"/>

cases.name: marker as a data: URI
cases.svg: <defs><marker id="{p}m"><path d="M0 0 L1 1"/></marker></defs><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="9" y2="9" marker-end="url(data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2Zy8+#{p}m)"/>

cases.name: marker reference in quotes
cases.svg: <defs><marker id="{p}m"><path d="M0 0 L1 1"/></marker></defs><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="9" y2="9" marker-end="url('#{p}m')"/>

cases.name: marker reference inside a marker (a chain)
cases.svg: <defs><marker id="{p}m"><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1" marker-end="url(#{p}n)"/></marker><marker id="{p}n"><path d="M0 0 L1 1"/></marker></defs><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="9" y2="9" marker-mid="url(#{p}n)"/>
